senses.gloss:
अ, ए and ओ are called गुण।

Terms: गुण

That which is enjoined to come in th room of what follows is to be understood as coming in the room only of the first letter thereof.

Terms:

In a root, which is the system of grammatical instruction (i.e. the धातुपाठ), ends with a dipthong (ए , ऐ , ओ, औ), there is the substitution of आ for the dipthong, provided that no affix with an indicatory श् follows it.

Terms: सम्प्रसारणम्

ष् is substituted for that स् which is a substitute (of the ष् of a root in the धातुपाठ by धात्वादेः षः सः ६.१.६४) or which is (the portion of) an affix, under the above mentioned conditions -- इण्कोः ८.३.५७, नुम्विसर्जनीयशर्व्यवायेऽपि ८.३.५८, of being preceded by an इण् vowel or a guttural.

Terms: ष् change
